page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Single column of text with line numbers in the right margin (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30) as marginal numbers. Chapter heading centred mid-page, then a paragraph with a drop cap. Catchword-like signature line at foot ("d 5 Sunt") is a signature.

main_text.p: μὲν λίγεν nugari, & poeticas metaphoras loqui, Deniq; formam,ait, σαφῶς ... ἀπεδλίδοκιν, perspicuè nullus expofuit: amavit nempe philosophus hic noster laudis hujus etiá patrimoniū.

5Muri ] Ut fuperiora,efficientis & materię exem pla,fic fequentia,formæ & finis: quávis unicum argumentum, multis tamen verbis arguunt & interpretantur.In Cęsaris exemplo, eft etiá materia in trabibus,aggere,faxis:eft etiam finis,ad propugnationem urbium:fed forma ipfa é materiæ perpetua difpofitione atq; ordine,graphi cé informatur, nec feré in exéplo ullo materiá folam deprehendes. Virgiliani ] Forma portus á Virgilio talis affingitur, qualis omnino pofsit optari, non qualis revera fit: Servius talem portū ait fuiffe Carthaginis nouæ in Hifpania, nec ufquam effe in Africa. Pari veró elegátia portus pingitur é finu,infula, rupibus, fcopulis,nemore,aqua dulci, fedilibus : & finis etiá attingitur, quód hic & naves,& nautæ recreentur.
main_text.head: Cap. VIII. De Fine.
main_text.p: FInis, eft cauffa cujus gratiâ res eft, Phyficis rebus finis homo propofitus eft,homini Deus. Omniū artiū eft aliquod fummumbonum & finis extremus,ut Grămaticę,bene loqui:Rhetoricę,bene dicere: Logicę,bene differere. Iuno 1. Aeneidos, connubii finem aflumit,cúm Aeolo Dejopejam pollicetur, folatii fcilicet prolifque gratia.

page.notes: Marginal line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 are printed in the margin; the Greek words in the first paragraph are transcribed approximately and the middle of the Greek phrase is uncertain. The word "Sunt" at the foot is a catchword-style marking; the sequence "d 5" is a signature mark.
